subject: MONTA | raw rank207

evidence.finding: Monta Hub is CPO pricing infrastructure supporting operator-defined public/member/roaming/partner rates, dynamic prices, fees and per-charge-point rules.
Monta public CPO-pricing portal exposes French EVSE under underlying operators such as R3, Sowatt Solutions, WAAT and GEEVE rather than establishing MONTA as the unique direct retail authority.
Existing France audits already separated Monta CPO->eMSP/roaming pricing from direct host/CPO pricing for ANYOS and GEEVE.

decision: raw207 becomes non-counting platform/supervision lineage; do not create MONTA direct CPO tariff authority and do not inherit Monta portal roaming/CPO-export prices as direct tariffs
